Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GOOGL.
We generated $19.2 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $19.9 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2019.
Our cloud segment grew 25% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 136 basis points to 63.1%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
